races.paceDynamic: Ruby's Profit will take the field along as the sole confirmed front-runner, likely getting an uncontested lead through moderate fractions. The prominent runners Canon's House, Seven Questions, Smart Vision, Dapper Valley and Roach Power will track behind but none are aggressive enough pace-pressers to force Ruby's Profit into a duel. This creates a tactical race where the pace will be steady rather than searching, with Ruby's Profit able to dictate terms before the field quickens in the final two furlongs. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and hold-up horses with a turn of foot, as Ruby's Profit may kick clear but struggle to sustain in the closing stages without early pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Canon's House, Seven Questions or Dapper Valley can sit second or third behind Ruby's Profit's moderate pace.
scenarios.body: The tactical pace allows these prominent runners to conserve energy while staying close enough to strike, with their ability to quicken off a steady gallop proving decisive in the final furlong. Ruby's Profit sets it up perfectly but lacks the class to hold off the closers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and bunches the field, creating a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace compression allows Roman Dragon, Dubai Bling or Vintage Clarets to get into contention despite their hold-up styles, with superior class telling in a cavalry charge finish. The prominent runners get caught in traffic as the field compacts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Ruby's Profit faces no serious challenge through the early stages and gets soft sectionals.
scenarios.body: Ruby's Profit capitalizes on the uncontested lead by gradually increasing the tempo from halfway, building an unassailable advantage that the closers cannot reel in despite their late rally. The 125lbs burden becomes manageable with tactical control.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Ruby's Profit goes too slowly and multiple horses challenge simultaneously in the final two furlongs.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble where early position matters less than raw speed, potentially suiting an outsider like Roach Power or Smart Vision who can produce a sharp turn of foot. The favourite types get swamped in a blanket finish.

Canon's House and Dapper Valley both settle kindly in the first three, as either trapped wide or racing keenly could end chances

races.paceDynamic: Furturra is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead, setting a steady gallop around Chester's tight turns. Paper View and Donegal Rose are the only other prominent types, but with limited early pace pressure, they're likely to track just behind rather than challenge Furturra early. This sustainable tempo will allow hold-up horses like Caturra Lights, Jazz Queen, Undercover Affair, and Sunrise At Dawn to get into contention turning for home. The lack of genuine pace pressure strongly favours closers who can produce their best work late on Chester's short straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Capitalize Late
scenarios.trigger: If Furturra sets modest fractions and the pace collapses late
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get perfect positioning to unleash finishing kicks, with the best closers sweeping past tired leaders in the final furlong. Chester's configuration rewards this patient approach when early pace is pedestrian.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Persist
scenarios.trigger: If Paper View and Donegal Rose track the leader closely and stay on
scenarios.body: These two experienced runners use their positional advantage to hold off late challenges, benefiting from being closer to a modest pace. Their previous 5f experience at similar tracks proves crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the debutants shows exceptional natural ability
scenarios.body: Dubai Champion or Koodini could possess untapped class that overcomes their inexperience, using Chester's unique demands to their advantage. Their fresh legs and unknown potential create upset possibilities.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Leader Lasts Home
scenarios.trigger: If Furturra's uncontested lead proves insurmountable and he stays strong
scenarios.body: The front runner capitalizes on soft fractions and holds on grimly, benefiting from having no early pressure and getting first run on his rivals. His recent Catterick fourth suggests some ability.

scenarios.label: C
